evidence_items.claim: Bank of America is among G-SIB backers of digital derivatives reporting project
evidence_items.excerpt: Bank of America Merrill Lynch, BNP Paribas, Citi, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan are among the project's backers; Bloomberg is also participating. The project is training 25 G-SIB-supplied specialists to study the data fields required for the EMIR refit implementation.

evidence_items.claim: Bank of America is fourth-largest global OTC derivatives dealer
evidence_items.excerpt: Bank of America climbed four spots to become the fourth-largest dealer of over-the-counter derivatives globally in 2024.
